subject: Quality checks before furniture leaves the workshop
hook: What do you check before my trade order is ready?
fb:
A question fitters often ask us, and a fair one: "What do you actually check before my order's ready?"

Every part is measured against your cutting list, checked square, edging inspected for lift and overhang, drilling checked against your drawing, and faces looked over for marks. Then it's labelled to your list and wrapped.

A clear cutting list makes all of that quicker, so send yours over and ask us anything about trade orders below.
https://superiofurniture.com/trade-services/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=craftsmanship-behind-the-finish&utm_content=day-301
gbp:
"What do you check before my trade order is ready?"

Every order cut in SUPERIO Furniture's Hanley workshop is checked before it's released for collection or delivery:
- Each part measured against your cutting list
- Panels and assembled carcasses checked square by measuring both diagonals
- ABS edging inspected for bond, flush trimming and clean corners
- Hinge cups, shelf-pin rows and dowel holes checked against your drawing
- Faces inspected for chips and marks
- Every part labelled to your list and wrapped

The clearer the cutting list, the smoother this goes, so include board type and colour, finished sizes, grain direction, edges to band and thickness, and any drilling drawings.

We offer panel cutting, ABS edge banding, panel drilling and cabinet assembly. Workshop collection is by arrangement and delivery is quoted per job.

Learn more about our trade services and send your cutting list for a priced quote.
